Canvas.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.zh: 实验性：按立牌锚点深度决定遮挡；同深度时按图层顺序。贴面参与遮挡，画布底色和网格始终位于所有图层下方。
Canvas.DepthPriorityOcclusionHint.en: Experimental: order occlusion by billboard anchor depth, using layer order at equal depth. Surface layers participate; canvas color and grid remain beneath all layers.

Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.zh: 固定逻辑格长和钉点处的网格相位。调整四角时，图层保持与原格线对齐，框内覆盖格数自动变化；屏幕上的格子仍可随透视缩短。
Canvas.GridSizeLockHelp.en: Keep logical cell spacing and the grid phase at the pin. Corner adjustments retain layer-to-grid alignment and automatically change coverage; perspective can still shorten cells on screen.

Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.zh: 当前覆盖格数自动计算，可能含部分格；悬停可查看完整精度。取消锁定后恢复整数行列输入。重置按当前覆盖数重建正方形网格。
Canvas.GridSizeLockCountsHint.en: Coverage is calculated automatically and may include partial cells; hover for full precision. Unlock to edit integer counts. Reset rebuilds square cells for the current coverage.

Canvas.GridSizeHelp.zh: 格子的边长，使用与矩形宽高相同的画布单位。非透视画布工具可从任意位置起拖，包括图层像素；远离主屏中心放大，靠近缩小。网格交点始终固定在主屏中心。
Canvas.GridSizeHelp.en: Cell side length, in the same canvas units as rectangle width and height. In flat Canvas mode, start dragging anywhere, including over layers. Move away from the primary-screen center to enlarge cells, or toward it to shrink them; that center remains a grid intersection.

Canvas.GuideOpacityHint.zh: 仅调整画布工具的参考网格，0% 隐藏。显示实体网格时会进一步减淡。只在本次运行中保留，重启后恢复 100%，不写入画布或预设。
Canvas.GuideOpacityHint.en: Adjust only the Canvas tool's reference grid; 0% hides it. Show grid dims it further. Kept for this run only and reset to 100% after restart, without changing the canvas or presets.

Canvas.HelpText.zh: 按 C 选择画布工具，再次点击画布按钮打开设置。平面模式下，左键拖动网格，在工具属性中调整格长，也可输入网格 X／Y；中间的对齐按钮将网格交点放到当前钉点。钉点默认在主屏中心，随视图平移和缩放；还原或应用视图后回到中心。画布工具在平面和透视下都显示参考网格，可用标题栏透明度调淡或隐藏。原点表示文档 (0,0)，移动网格不移动文档或钉点。透视模式可直接拖动角点、边缘或中央手柄，也可用四点／四线重新建立透视。采集时暂时隐藏其他窗口，完成或取消后恢复。按住空格临时导航；参考透明度仅本次运行有效。显示网格只控制绘制及其外观选项，不隐藏格距和位置。Esc 取消当前拖动或关闭未固定设置；平面格距与位置独立保存，不改写透视校准。
Canvas.HelpText.en: Press C to select Canvas; select it again to open settings. In flat mode, drag to move the grid, use tool options to change spacing, or enter grid X/Y. The button between them aligns a grid intersection to the current pin. The pin starts at the primary screen center and follows view pan and zoom; resetting or applying the view returns it to the center. Canvas shows reference grid lines in both flat and perspective modes, with caption opacity to dim or hide them. Origin marks document (0,0); moving the grid does not move the document or pin. In perspective mode, drag corners, edges or the center, or establish a new plane with four points or four lines. Sampling temporarily hides other windows and restores them on completion or cancellation. Hold Space to navigate; reference opacity lasts for this run only. Show grid controls rendering and appearance fields, while spacing and position stay available. Esc cancels the current drag or closes unpinned settings. Flat spacing and position are stored independently of perspective calibration.

Canvas.InvalidGrid.zh: 列数和行数须为 1 至 256 的整数。
Canvas.InvalidGrid.en: Columns and rows must be integers from 1 to 256.

Canvas.InvalidQuad.zh: 四个角点须构成不交叉的凸四边形。
Canvas.InvalidQuad.en: The four corners must form a convex quadrilateral.

Canvas.UnstableProjection.zh: 透视变换过于极端，请调整四个角。
Canvas.UnstableProjection.en: The perspective is too extreme. Adjust the four corners.

Canvas.SafetyTitle.zh: 处理透视范围外的图层

Canvas.UnsafeLayerSummary.zh: 有 {0} 个图层超出安全绘制范围，需要选择处理方式。
Canvas.UnsafeLayerSummary.en: {0} layers are outside the safe drawing range. Choose how to handle them.

Canvas.SafetyHelpText.zh:
数量包含需要一起处理的关联组合成员，隐藏和锁定图层也在其中。

取消本次调整：恢复本次拖动前的透视和图层状态。

应用并移回图层（推荐）：将图层或整个组合移到四点框内或屏幕上的开阔安全位置，保留原始内容、尺寸及组合关系。找不到合适位置时，此选项不可用。

应用并删除这些图层：删除提示涉及的图层及关联组合成员，包括隐藏和锁定图层。

应用并保留图层（慎用）：应用新透视，保留全部图层的原始内容、尺寸、位置、组合、显隐和锁定状态。越界部分可能被裁剪或暂时不可见，调回原透视后恢复显示。

本次透视调整与图层处理可以一次撤销。
Canvas.SafetyHelpText.en:
The count includes related group members that must be handled together, including hidden and locked layers.

Cancel this adjustment: restore the perspective and layer state from before this gesture.

Apply and move layers back (recommended): move layers or whole groups to an open safe area inside the reference frame or screen, preserving original content, size and group relationships. This option is unavailable if no suitable position is found.

Apply and delete these layers: delete the affected layers and related group members, including hidden and locked layers.

Apply and keep layers (use caution): apply the new perspective while preserving every layer's content, size, position, groups, visibility and locked state. Unsafe parts may be clipped or temporarily hidden until the original perspective is restored.

The perspective adjustment and layer changes can be undone together in one step.

Canvas.RelocateFailed.zh: 无法在保持图层尺寸和组合关系的前提下找到安全位置。可以取消本次调整、删除这些图层，或慎用原样保留。
Canvas.RelocateFailed.en: No safe position was found while preserving layer size and group relationships. Cancel this adjustment, delete these layers, or keep them unchanged with caution.

Canvas.PinHelp.zh: 从固定默认参照确定钉点，再映射到当前四边形。默认状态切换钉点不移动图层；相同四角、行列数和钉点得到相同显示，不累积调整过程。图层数值保持，视觉可发生形变。
Canvas.PinHelp.en: The pin is derived from the fixed default reference and mapped into the current quad. Switching pins in the default state leaves layers unchanged. Identical corners, counts and pin give the same view regardless of edit history; layer values stay unchanged.

Canvas.PinHalfCells.zh: 当前钉点仍是网格交点；奇数方向的框边会有半格。匹配完整格范围可选择角点。
Canvas.PinHalfCells.en: The pin stays on a grid intersection. Odd counts leave half cells at these frame edges; choose a corner to fit complete cells.
